description: A WORKER'S OWN COIN: give the public address of your own wallet, a name and a symbol and read the plan for a coin of your own: a supply of 1,000, 900 into the first floor and 100 kept whole in your wallet, the first floor against ECO worth $10 at a priced read (ECO is EcoWealth's own token: EcoWealth holds it and gains if it rises), the second floor's rule, and what your own wallet would sign, in order. It launches nothing. The house holds, signs, buys, sells and launches nothing, there is no fee and no reward, and nothing here is advice. The live priced read of ECO and the launch provider are not built yet: until the priced read is, the plan is refused and says so, and nothing is guessed; and no transaction is ever built here. The program is built but not switched on, and a legal read comes before any live step. Free and keyless: it takes an address only, never a private key, and it stores nothing. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign here; if a coin is ever launched, the person signs with their own wallet, and the house never holds a key.

name.description: The coin's name: 3 to 32 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, apostrophes or dashes. It does not borrow the house's names.

symbol.description: The coin's symbol: 2 to 8 capital letters or numbers. It does not borrow the house's names.

wallet.description: The public 0x address of your own wallet, the one that would sign. Address only, never a private key.

name: prepare_net_workers_coin_plan
title: Read a dry launch plan for a coin of your own (keyless, nothing to sign)
